data.narrative: The student used progressive decomposition to implement Team Collaboration across bounded tasks with explicit schema, authorization, invitation, event ordering, comments, and audit invariants. They adjusted the recipient contract to bind invitations to an explicit principal ID instead of inventing an email mapping. The code and 74-line integration spec are present, but runtime end-to-end validation remains blocked: the requested service-spec path matched no tests, and the full integration run could not reach local PostgreSQL; migrations remain unapplied.

dimension_scores.observation: The work was divided into bounded tasks with clear acceptance criteria and security constraints.
dimension_scores.evidence: Tasks 1–9 specify schema, live role enforcement, recipient binding, replay and expiry behavior, ordered activity, comments/mentions, audit access, and a 150-line ceiling per task.

dimension_scores.observation: The implementation plan and integration spec cover the important cross-feature invariants, but the database-backed assertions could not complete in this environment.
dimension_scores.evidence: The 74-line teams.collaboration.spec.ts covers roles, invitations, activity cursors, comments/mentions, and audit access; its initial POST /teams received 500 when PostgreSQL refused the connection.

dimension_scores.observation: Progressive task sizing enabled incremental implementation and made a missing recipient identity mapping visible before acceptance behavior was committed.
dimension_scores.evidence: The invitation contract was bound to explicit inviteeUserId/principalId, and task changes stayed within the 150-line limit; Task 9's spec is 74 lines.

dimension_scores.observation: The student preserved trust boundaries by failing closed on unbound recipients and by distinguishing written coverage from verified runtime behavior.
dimension_scores.evidence: The reflection records that the principal has no verified email mapping, reports the exact no-tests-found targeted command, and does not claim the blocked integration test passed.

dimension_scores.observation: The feature artifacts and verification plan are comprehensive, while database-backed end-to-end behavior still needs a reachable test database and applied migrations.
dimension_scores.evidence: git diff --check exited 0; the full Jest run was 7/8 suites and 34/35 tests with the integration test blocked at localhost PostgreSQL; no migrations were applied.

strengths: Decomposed a multi-boundary feature into reviewable changes within the per-task line limit.
Applied live role checks, recipient-bound single-use invitations, transactional activity sequencing, and member-scoped comment behavior.
Reported test and environment limitations without presenting unverified runtime behavior as proven.
growth_areas: Complete database-backed integration verification after PostgreSQL is available and pending migrations are applied to the guarded test database.
data.recommendation: When the local test environment is restored, apply pending migrations only through prisma7.test.config.ts against url_shortener_test, run the full Jest suite, and record the resulting integration evidence before relying on the API behavior.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: The learner chose Option B and used bounded tasks with verification points before dependent implementation.
Invitation acceptance is bound to an explicit principal ID because no verified email mapping is available.
The learner distinguishes the 34 passing existing tests from the blocked integration test and the no-match targeted Jest command.

teaching_approaches.detail: Small implementation tasks were followed by explicit checks before proceeding to dependent work.

learning_style_signals: Uses concrete commands, task-specific evidence, and explicit boundaries between implementation and runtime proof.

public_evidence.artifact: Team Collaboration implementation and Module 2 reflection
public_evidence.student_action: Implemented the feature through bounded tasks and documented its invariants, verification results, and remaining environment limitations.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Prisma team/invitation/activity/comment models; team routes and service; live role guard; ordered event cursor; integration spec.
public_evidence.proof: Task 9 integration spec is 74 lines; git diff --check exited 0; targeted Jest reported no matching teams.service.spec.ts, while the full run's integration case was blocked by PostgreSQL connection refusal.
public_evidence.ability: Decomposes and evaluates a multi-layer engineering change with explicit evidence boundaries.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Shows how the implementation addresses security and consistency requirements while identifying what still needs runtime verification.
